name: ECC
description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
one_liner: An add-on toolkit that makes AI coding assistants remember more, work more safely, and perform better across long projects.
buyer: An engineering team lead running Claude Code or similar agents on a private codebase who's hit problems with the AI losing context, making unsafe changes, or forgetting past decisions.
business_use_cases: A mid-size dev team installs the 'agentshield' security layer to stop their AI coding agent from running risky commands unsupervised.
A consultancy uses the memory/instincts system so an AI agent retains client-specific conventions across many separate engagements.
An engineering org pays for the private-repo tier so their proprietary code can safely use these AI-agent enhancements.

money_ideas.idea: The project itself already sells private-repo access starting at $19/seat/month — a reseller or implementation partner could offer paid setup and training on top.
Offer a paid security review service that audits a company's AI-agent setup and configures this toolkit's safety guards for them.

steal_this: This weekend, offer a fixed-price 'AI agent safety audit' package for small dev shops: install this toolkit, configure the guardrails, and hand over a short report.
